authority: EXISTING Cognigrex.cgx and owner source roots only; this is a compatible subordinate carrier and not a new master format

orthogonality.x_y_z: Physical carrier Morton3 chunk lattice only. Semantic XY/Z/T graph remains the existing CGX authority and can be mapped using a registered lens.
orthogonality.layer_id: Ordinal modulo variable N; labels are not discovered meaning.
orthogonality.t: State root, history or revision is external to geometry address, never inferred from byte position.
orthogonality.n: N is 1..128 in demonstration implementation, not a universal physical or philosophical constant.
orthogonality.small_key: Single root/reference can replace previously shared content only when recipient already has exact bytes and decoder; key is not encryption or an authority lease.

read_variation_states.R0_EXACT: Bitwise-reversible byte carrier or referenced full byte stream
read_variation_states.R1_SEMANTIC_REVERSIBLE: ONLY when a separately validated typed adapter and reverse transformer prove semantic recovery
read_variation_states.R2_STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTED: Rebuilt format/structure; original byte identity not claimed
read_variation_states.R3_GENERATIVE_INFERRED: AI or algorithm generated/inferred; source identity not claimed
read_variation_states.NOT_CACHED: Missing required exact source root or chunk
read_variation_states.UNKNOWN_SEMANTICS: No registered interpretation dictionary or context
read_variation_states.UNSUPPORTED_VIEW: Reader capability not declared or installed
read_variation_states.WITHHELD: Known but not available through current owner/permission scope
read_variation_states.NO_CHANGE: Verified identity to prior State_Root; not necessarily a transmitted payload
read_variation_states.ZERO: Measured/derived numeric zero with explicit evidence; never a null

fuel_fuel.primary_proof: Compare complete initial transfer, repeat transfer, conditional root+delta, compressed source, decode CPU, memory, latency and actual target device energy when measured
fuel_fuel.selection: Choose minimal validated effective cost; bypass CGX envelope when raw/ZIP is more efficient for cold share; preserve source-root identity out of band
fuel_fuel.cost_equation: C = a*B_wire + b*T_cpu_ms + c*B_storage + d*Latency_ms + e*Risk; a..e are context weights; NOT physical joules unless calibrated
fuel_fuel.unknown_cost: Return unknown/HOLD or bounded exploration; do not claim benefit without measured target hardware
fuel_fuel.break_even: A warm-key delta only saves transmission when the exact full source/decoder are already present; initial cache cost must be amortised.

security.limits: 128 MiB source, 4096 chunks, 8 MiB decompressed manifest, 128 layers; validation rejects corruption, oversized payloads, mismatched bases, invalid geometry and unexpected overwrites

integration_proposal.entry: Optional R0 byte-carrier adapter behind existing source-native open/read/verify; not a replacement for CGX-IR
integration_proposal.data_space: Root negotiation and delta readback only under existing authenticated node lease
integration_proposal.print_space: Only registered material/CAD/process adapters, never compile bytes directly into machine motion
integration_proposal.public_unispace: Show read-only source-bound costs and synthetic examples; no public upload of private customer data
owner_gates: Test real native source adapter and provider revision
verified_functional_cases: R0 exact source root readback for raw/ZIP/CGXS cold
